llm_response.Content: An in-place reindex can leave old whole-file bodies on parent documents if the reindexing process does not properly handle document lifecycle management, such as cache management and buffer usage. After rebuilding, it is recommended to await a readiness signal indicating that the system is prepared for the new state of the documents.

synthesis_outcome.Answer: An in-place reindex can leave old whole-file bodies on parent documents if the reindexing process does not properly handle document lifecycle management, such as cache management and buffer usage. After rebuilding, it is recommended to await a readiness signal indicating that the system is prepared for the new state of the documents.
